cues.setup: Stand an arm-length from a sturdy box, feet hip-width.
cues.exec: Swing arms, jump onto the box, land soft in a quarter squat, step down.
cues.fix: Landing loud? Pick a lower box and stick each landing quietly.

cues.setup: Stand tall, feet shoulder-width, hands free.
cues.exec: Squat, kick back to a push-up, press up, hop feet in, jump tall.
cues.fix: Back sagging in the plank? Brace the core before kicking back.

cues.setup: Stand tall, arms bent at 90 degrees.
cues.exec: Drive knees to hip height with quick steps, pump the arms.
cues.fix: Leaning back? Keep ribs down and land under your hips.

cues.setup: Stand upright, arms at your sides.
cues.exec: Jump feet wide while arms sweep overhead, snap back together.
cues.fix: Heels slamming? Stay springy on the balls of your feet.

cues.setup: High plank, hands under shoulders, body straight.
cues.exec: Drive knees to the chest alternately, hips stay level.
cues.fix: Hips piking up? Slow down and keep the plank line.

cues.setup: Elbows close, rope handles at hip height.
cues.exec: Spin from the wrists, small two-footed hops, stay tall.
cues.fix: Jumping too high? An inch of air is enough — save the calves.

cues.setup: Kneel, hands on the wheel under the shoulders, hips tucked.
cues.exec: Roll out slowly as far as the flat back allows, pull back with the abs.
cues.fix: Lower back arching? Shorten the rollout and re-tuck the pelvis.

cues.setup: Lie on a bench, grip it behind your head, legs together.
cues.exec: Raise the body to the shoulders, lower as one straight line.
cues.fix: Hips breaking the line? Lower only as far as you stay rigid.

cues.setup: Wide grip on the pole: top arm pulls, bottom arm presses.
cues.exec: Lift the body sideways to horizontal, stack hips and shoulders.
cues.fix: Hips rotating open? Squeeze glutes and keep the chest square.

cues.setup: Dead hang, shoulders lightly packed, legs together.
cues.exec: Raise straight legs to hip height, lower with control.
cues.fix: Swinging? Pause at the bottom until the body is still.

cues.setup: Lie on your back, arms overhead, legs long.
cues.exec: Press the lower back down, hover arms and legs, hold and breathe.
cues.fix: Lower back lifting? Raise the legs higher or bend the knees.

cues.setup: Hands beside the hips, fingers forward, shoulders down.
cues.exec: Press tall, lift the hips, hold the legs straight out in front.
cues.fix: Legs dropping? Tuck the knees first and build the hold time.

cues.setup: Forearms down, elbows under shoulders, toes tucked.
cues.exec: Squeeze glutes, ribs down, one straight line — breathe.
cues.fix: Hips sagging? Tuck the pelvis and shorten the set.

cues.setup: Dead hang, grip crushed, body still.
cues.exec: Fold at the hips and bring the toes all the way to the bar.
cues.fix: Using swing? Lower slower — the way down builds the control.

cues.setup: Hang, raise the legs to the bar first.
cues.exec: Sweep the straight legs side to side like wipers, torso quiet.
cues.fix: Losing height? Rebuild toes-to-bar strength before adding reps.

edges.note: erst Beine sicher zur Stange bringen

cues.setup: Full grip on the bar, thumbs wrapped.
cues.exec: Hang with relaxed shoulders, crush the bar, breathe calmly.
cues.fix: Shoulders at the ears hurting? Pack them slightly down and hold.

cues.setup: Grip the bar with one hand, thumb wrapped, shoulder set.
cues.exec: Release the helper hand, hang still, keep the shoulder packed.
cues.fix: Body spinning? Touch the helper hand back until it calms.

cues.setup: Drape a towel over the bar, grip both ends high.
cues.exec: Hang from the towel only — pure crush grip, body still.
cues.fix: Grip failing fast? Alternate towel and bar hangs each set.

cues.setup: Shoulder blades pinned, feet planted, slight arch.
cues.exec: Bar to mid-chest, press to lockout, elbows ~45 degrees.
cues.fix: Flaring elbows? Tuck them and shorten the arch.

cues.setup: Rear foot on the bench, dumbbells at the sides, front shin vertical.
cues.exec: Lower until the front thigh is parallel, drive through the whole foot.
cues.fix: Knee caving in? Lighter dumbbells, push the knee over the toes.

cues.setup: Kneel facing the stack, rope beside the ears.
cues.exec: Crunch ribs toward pelvis against the cable, hips still.
cues.fix: Pulling with the arms? Lock them — only the spine flexes.

cues.setup: Sit tall, feet braced, grab the handle with long arms.
cues.exec: Pull to the belly, squeeze the blades, control the return.
cues.fix: Torso rocking? Freeze the hips and let the back do the work.

cues.setup: Balls of the feet on the platform, heels free.
cues.exec: Full stretch at the bottom, pause high on the toes.
cues.fix: Bouncing? Two seconds down, one second pause at both ends.

cues.setup: Stand tall, dumbbells at the sides, palms in.
cues.exec: Curl one arm, rotate the palm up on the way, lower slow.
cues.fix: Swinging the torso? Pin the elbows to the ribs and go lighter.

cues.setup: Dumbbells at the sides, chest tall.
cues.exec: Big step forward, rear knee toward the floor, push back up.
cues.fix: Wobbling? Shorter steps and eyes on a fixed point.

cues.setup: One hand and knee on the bench, flat back, dumbbell hanging long.
cues.exec: Pull the dumbbell to the hip, elbow close, lower with control.
cues.fix: Twisting up? Keep both shoulders square to the floor.

cues.setup: Dumbbells at shoulder height, ribs down, glutes tight.
cues.exec: Press overhead until the arms lock, lower to the ears.
cues.fix: Arching the back? Brace the core or press seated.

cues.setup: Bar over mid-foot, grip just outside the legs, flat back.
cues.exec: Push the floor away, bar close to the shins, stand tall.
cues.fix: Back rounding? Reset the hips and take weight off the bar.

edges.note: Hinge-Muster mit kuerzerem Weg zuerst schulen

cues.setup: Grip the EZ bar at the angled bends, elbows at the ribs.
cues.exec: Curl to the chest without swinging, lower in two seconds.
cues.fix: Elbows drifting forward? Pin them and finish lower.

cues.setup: Rope at face height, step back until the cable is taut.
cues.exec: Pull to the face, elbows high, rotate the knuckles back.
cues.fix: Shrugging? Lower the weight and lead with the elbows.

cues.setup: Bar racked on the front delts, elbows high, full grip or fingertips.
cues.exec: Sit straight down between the hips, torso upright, stand tall.
cues.fix: Elbows dropping? Mobilize wrists and lats, lighten the bar.

cues.setup: Upper back on the bench, bar over the hips, feet planted.
cues.exec: Drive the hips to full lockout, chin tucked, squeeze at the top.
cues.fix: Overarching at the top? Ribs down — finish with the glutes.

cues.setup: Bench at ~30 degrees, dumbbells at the shoulders.
cues.exec: Press up and slightly together, lower to a full chest stretch.
cues.fix: Wrists tipping back? Stack knuckles over forearms.

cues.setup: Thighs under the pad, wide grip, chest tall.
cues.exec: Pull the bar to the collarbone, elbows down, control the way up.
cues.fix: Leaning way back? Slight lean only — the lats pull, not gravity.

cues.setup: Stand tall, dumbbells at the sides, slight elbow bend.
cues.exec: Raise to shoulder height leading with the elbows, lower slow.
cues.fix: Shrugging up? Lighter weights, pause a beat at the top.

cues.setup: Pad just above the heels, hips pressed into the bench.
cues.exec: Curl the pad to the glutes, lower in three seconds.
cues.fix: Hips lifting? Lower the weight and pin them down.

cues.setup: Pad on the shins, knees aligned with the machine pivot.
cues.exec: Extend to a full squeeze, lower slowly without slamming.
cues.fix: Knees hurting? Reduce range at the bottom and go lighter.

cues.setup: Feet mid-platform, hip-width, back flat on the pad.
cues.exec: Lower deep under control, press without locking out hard.
cues.fix: Lower back curling off the pad? Shorten the depth.

cues.setup: Bar at the collarbone, grip just outside shoulders, glutes tight.
cues.exec: Press straight up past the face, lock out overhead, head through.
cues.fix: Ribs flaring? Squeeze glutes and brace before the press.

cues.setup: Soft knees, bar against the thighs, shoulders over the bar.
cues.exec: Hinge the hips back, bar slides down the legs, stand tall.
cues.fix: Bar drifting away? Drag it along the thighs the whole way.

cues.setup: Hinge to ~45 degrees, flat back, dumbbells hanging.
cues.exec: Sweep the arms wide, thumbs slightly down, pause at the top.
cues.fix: Using momentum? Lighter weights, strict two-second lowers.

cues.setup: Hinge to ~45 degrees, flat back, grip outside the knees.
cues.exec: Pull the bar to the lower ribs, no body English, lower slow.
cues.fix: Torso bouncing? Lighten the bar and freeze the hinge.

cues.setup: Lie back, EZ bar over the chest, hands at the narrow bends.
cues.exec: Lower to the forehead with still elbows, extend back up.
cues.fix: Elbows flaring? Narrow the path and drop the weight.

cues.setup: Bar on the upper back, grip tight, brace before unracking.
cues.exec: Sit between the hips to full depth, drive up through mid-foot.
cues.fix: Chest collapsing? Brace harder and slow the descent.

cues.setup: Elbows pinned to the sides, slight forward lean.
cues.exec: Press the cable to lockout, squeeze, let it rise with control.
cues.fix: Elbows drifting up? Reset them at the ribs every rep.

cues.setup: Rear foot on a bench, front shin vertical, hips square.
cues.exec: Lower until the front thigh is parallel, drive through the foot.
cues.fix: Hips twisting? Narrow the stance and slow the descent.

cues.setup: Balls of the feet on an edge, heels hanging free.
cues.exec: Full stretch at the bottom, press high onto the toes, pause.
cues.fix: Rushing? Three seconds up-pause-down beats twenty bounces.

cues.setup: Feet shoulder-width, arms ready to swing.
cues.exec: Squat deep, explode up, land soft back into the squat.
cues.fix: Knees caving on landing? Land wider and absorb quietly.

cues.setup: Stand tall, hands on hips or free.
cues.exec: Big step forward, rear knee near the floor, push back up.
cues.fix: Front heel lifting? Longer step, weight through the whole foot.

cues.setup: Kneel with the ankles anchored, hips extended, body tall.
cues.exec: Lower the torso forward as slowly as possible, catch with hands.
cues.fix: Breaking at the hips? Keep glutes tight — bend only at the knees.

cues.setup: Stand on one leg, other leg and arms reaching forward.
cues.exec: Sit to full depth on one leg, heel down, stand back up.
cues.fix: Falling backward? Hold a counterweight forward or use a box.

cues.setup: Stand on one leg, grab the other foot behind you.
cues.exec: Lower until the rear knee kisses the floor, drive back up.
cues.fix: Knee slamming down? Slow the last inches — touch, do not drop.

cues.setup: Feet hip-width, hold something for balance at first.
cues.exec: Knees travel far forward, torso leans back in one line, rise.
cues.fix: Knee pain? Reduce the lean and build range gradually.

cues.setup: Feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
cues.exec: Sit between the hips to full depth, chest tall, drive up.
cues.fix: Heels lifting? Widen the stance or elevate the heels slightly.

cues.setup: Back flat on the wall, feet out in front.
cues.exec: Slide down until thighs are parallel, hold and breathe.
cues.fix: Hands on the thighs? Arms crossed — no cheating the quads.

cues.setup: On all fours, hands under shoulders, knees under hips.
cues.exec: Round the whole spine on the exhale, arch it on the inhale.
cues.fix: Only the neck moving? Push the floor away, move rib by rib.

cues.setup: Wide grip on a band or stick, arms long.
cues.exec: Sweep overhead and behind in one slow arc, arms straight.
cues.fix: Elbows bending? Widen the grip until the circle is smooth.

cues.setup: Sit with both legs bent at 90 degrees.
cues.exec: Rotate the knees side to side, chest tall, hands free.
cues.fix: Collapsing sideways? Sit taller — height beats range here.

cues.setup: Front shin folded across, rear leg long behind.
cues.exec: Sink the hips square and level, breathe into the glute.
cues.fix: Front knee pinching? Slide the shin steeper toward the hip.

cues.setup: Side-lying, knees stacked at 90 degrees, arms together.
cues.exec: Open the top arm to the other side, follow with the eyes.
cues.fix: Knees separating? Pin them with the bottom hand.

cues.setup: Deep lunge, hands inside the front foot.
cues.exec: Drop the inside elbow, rotate open to the sky, then sit back.
cues.fix: Rear knee collapsing? Squeeze the rear glute the whole flow.

cues.setup: Kneel, palms down, fingers pointing each direction in turn.
cues.exec: Rock gently through all wrist angles, build pressure slowly.
cues.fix: Sharp pain? Shrink the range — load the edges gradually.

cues.setup: Stand an arm-length from a sturdy box, feet hip-width.
cues.exec: Swing arms, jump onto the box, land soft in a quarter squat, step down.
cues.fix: Landing loud? Pick a lower box and stick each landing quietly.

cues.setup: Feet hip-width, arms back, hips loaded.
cues.exec: Swing and jump for distance, stick the landing in a half squat.
cues.fix: Landing stiff-legged? Absorb through hips and knees.

cues.setup: Stand on a low box, toes at the edge.
cues.exec: Step off, land soft on both feet, freeze on impact, chest up.
cues.fix: Knees caving on impact? Lower box, land wider, freeze longer.

cues.setup: Stand beside a line, feet together, ankles springy.
cues.exec: Quick two-footed hops side to side, minimal ground contact.
cues.fix: Contacts getting long? Shorter sets — speed is the point.

cues.setup: Stand on one leg, hips slightly loaded.
cues.exec: Bound sideways leg to leg, hold each landing for a beat.
cues.fix: Wobbling on landing? Shorter bounds until each one sticks.

cues.setup: Start in a lunge, both knees at 90 degrees.
cues.exec: Jump, switch legs mid-air, land soft back in the lunge.
cues.fix: Landing hard? Lower jump height, prioritize quiet knees.

cues.setup: Warm up thoroughly, pick a hill or flat stretch.
cues.exec: Sprint all-out, tall posture, drive the arms, full recovery.
cues.fix: Overstriding? Land under the hips with quick, punchy steps.

cues.setup: Feet hip-width, arms ready.
cues.exec: Jump straight up, knees to the chest, land quiet, reset.
cues.fix: Reps getting sloppy? Stop the set — height and form count.

cues.setup: Wide grip, one arm ready to pull, the other straight.
cues.exec: Pull toward the working hand, the straight arm only guides.
cues.fix: Straight arm bending? Widen the grip, slow the negative.

cues.setup: Low bar, hang underneath, body straight, heels on the floor.
cues.exec: Pull the chest to the bar, squeeze the blades, lower slow.
cues.fix: Hips sagging? Squeeze glutes — plank rules apply here too.

cues.setup: Underhand grip, shoulder-width, dead hang.
cues.exec: Pull the chin over the bar, chest to the bar, lower fully.
cues.fix: Half reps? Full hang at the bottom — every rep from zero.

cues.setup: Hold a tuck or full front-lever angle under the bar.
cues.exec: Row the chest to the bar while the body stays horizontal.
cues.fix: Hips dropping mid-row? Regress the lever angle first.

cues.setup: Hang with legs held straight out at 90 degrees.
cues.exec: Pull up while the L holds, chin over the bar, lower slow.
cues.fix: Legs dropping? Fewer honest-L reps beat many without.

cues.setup: False grip or deep overhand grip, hollow body.
cues.exec: Explosive pull to the sternum, lean over the bar, press out.
cues.fix: Stuck at the transition? Slow transition negatives, low bar.

cues.setup: Overhand grip just outside shoulders, dead hang, core tight.
cues.exec: Pull the chin over the bar without swinging, lower fully.
cues.fix: Kipping in? Slow negatives until strict reps return.

cues.setup: Rings at hip height, walk the feet forward to set the angle.
cues.exec: Pull the chest to the rings, turn them out at the top.
cues.fix: Too easy or too hard? Move the feet — the angle is the load.

cues.setup: Wide hands, one arm straight out to the side.
cues.exec: Lower onto the bent arm, straight arm guides only.
cues.fix: Hips rotating? Brace and keep both shoulders square.

cues.setup: Hands form a diamond under the chest, body straight.
cues.exec: Lower the chest to the hands, elbows tracking back, press.
cues.fix: Elbows flaring wide? Keep them brushing the ribs.

cues.setup: Support on the bars, shoulders down, slight forward lean.
cues.exec: Lower until shoulders dip below elbows, press to lockout.
cues.fix: Shoulder pinching? Reduce depth and keep the lean forward.

cues.setup: Kick to a freestanding handstand, hands shoulder-width.
cues.exec: Lower the head to the floor with control, press to lockout.
cues.fix: Losing balance in the press? Build wall HSPU volume first.

cues.setup: Hips high in a pike, hands shoulder-width, heels down.
cues.exec: Lower the crown of the head to the floor, press back up.
cues.fix: Turning into a push-up? Keep the hips stacked over the hands.

cues.setup: Hands beside the hips, fingers back or out, lean forward.
cues.exec: Push-up while the shoulders stay in front of the hands.
cues.fix: Lean collapsing? Shift more weight forward before the rep.

cues.setup: Hands under the shoulders, body one straight line.
cues.exec: Chest to the floor, elbows ~45 degrees, press to lockout.
cues.fix: Hips sagging? Squeeze glutes and re-brace every rep.

cues.setup: Support on the rings, arms locked, rings turned slightly out.
cues.exec: Lower with the rings close to the body, press to lockout.
cues.fix: Rings wobbling wildly? Build the support hold first.

cues.setup: From an inverted hang, lower face-down, arms straight.
cues.exec: Hold the body horizontal facing the floor, glutes tight.
cues.fix: Shoulders screaming? More German hang prep, shorter holds.

cues.setup: Inverted hang, legs straddled wide.
cues.exec: Lower to horizontal face-down, legs wide, arms straight.
cues.fix: Hips rotating? Lower slower and fix the eyes on the floor.

cues.setup: Inverted hang, knees pulled to the chest.
cues.exec: Lower face-down to horizontal with tucked knees, arms straight.
cues.fix: Elbows bending? Turn the pits forward and lock hard.

cues.setup: Hang, shoulders packed, body hollow.
cues.exec: Pull the body to one horizontal line under the bar, arms straight.
cues.fix: Hips sagging? Back down a rung — the line is the exercise.

cues.setup: Tuck front lever first, back flat.
cues.exec: Open the hips until the thighs point out, back stays level.
cues.fix: Back rounding? Close the tuck and rebuild the flat back.

cues.setup: Hang, pull to horizontal, one leg extended, one tucked.
cues.exec: Hold the flat-back line, hips level, arms straight.
cues.fix: Extended leg dropping? Point the toes and squeeze the quad.

cues.setup: Hang, shoulders packed, legs ready to straddle.
cues.exec: Horizontal line with legs straight and split wide.
cues.fix: Line breaking? Narrow the straddle only as you get stronger.

cues.setup: Hang, pull the knees to the chest.
cues.exec: Pull the hips up until the back is flat and horizontal.
cues.fix: Back staying round? Pull the bar toward the hips harder.

cues.setup: Wide grip on the pole: top arm pulls, bottom arm presses.
cues.exec: Lift the body sideways to horizontal, stack hips and shoulders.
cues.fix: Hips rotating open? Squeeze glutes and keep the chest square.

cues.setup: Flag grip set, body ready to lift sideways.
cues.exec: Hold near horizontal with the legs split wide.
cues.fix: Sinking fast? Hold above horizontal and lower gradually.

cues.setup: Flag grip, jump the hips up, knees tucked.
cues.exec: Hold the tucked body off vertical, hips stacked sideways.
cues.fix: Bottom arm collapsing? Press the pole away like a push-up.

cues.setup: Flag grip on the pole, arms locked.
cues.exec: Support the body vertical beside the pole, top pulls, bottom presses.
cues.fix: Grip slipping? Chalk up and set the top hand higher.

cues.setup: Hands shoulder-width, fingers spread, eyes between the hands.
cues.exec: Kick up, stack hips over shoulders, balance with the fingers.
cues.fix: Banana back? Ribs down, tuck the pelvis, push tall.

cues.setup: Hands down a step from the wall, one leg ready to kick.
cues.exec: Kick up, catch the balance point, wall only as backstop.
cues.fix: Crashing over? Kick softer — find the wall with one heel.

cues.setup: Chest to the wall, walk up until the body is near vertical.
cues.exec: Push tall, hollow line, breathe through the hold.
cues.fix: Shoulders sagging? Push the floor away — grow an inch taller.

cues.setup: Support on parallettes, legs in a high V-sit.
cues.exec: Lean back, hands behind the hips, lift the legs past the face.
cues.fix: Stuck at V-sit? Reverse compression drills before attempts.

cues.setup: False grip or deep overhand grip, hollow body.
cues.exec: Explosive pull to the sternum, lean over the bar, press out.
cues.fix: Stuck at the transition? Slow transition negatives, low bar.

cues.setup: Tuck planche first, back flat, arms locked.
cues.exec: Open the hips until the back is flat, hips at shoulder height.
cues.fix: Falling forward? Less lean — the opening hips add the load.

cues.setup: Plank on straight arms, hands turned slightly out.
cues.exec: Lean forward until shoulders pass the wrists, hold, breathe.
cues.fix: Wrists complaining? Warm them up and lean a little less.

cues.setup: Lean into locked arms, hips rising, legs ready to open.
cues.exec: Hold the body horizontal, legs straight and split wide.
cues.fix: One hip dropping? Even out the lean before widening the legs.

cues.setup: Deep planche lean, knees pulled to the chest.
cues.exec: Feet leave the floor, hips high, full weight on straight arms.
cues.fix: Feet dipping back down? Deepen the lean, not the pull.

cues.setup: Hands down, fingers spread, shoulders far past the wrists.
cues.exec: Hover the straight body horizontal on locked arms.
cues.fix: Hips below shoulders? Back to straddle — earn the line first.

cues.setup: Support like an L-sit, hands beside the hips.
cues.exec: Lift the straight legs past 90 degrees toward the chest.
cues.fix: Knees bending? Raise only as far as the legs stay straight.
